definitions.explanation: A sour liquid made through fermentation, used as a condiment and in cooking. Essential for sushi rice.

It's said that vinegar is good for your health.

notes:
{酢|す} (vinegar) is one of the basic seasonings in Japanese cooking.

TYPES OF VINEGAR:
- {米酢|こめず}: rice vinegar (most common in Japan)
- {穀物酢|こくもつす}: grain vinegar
- りんご{酢|す}: apple cider vinegar
- {黒酢|くろず}: black vinegar
- {寿司酢|すしず}: sushi vinegar (pre-seasoned)

IN COOKING:
- {酢飯|すめし}: sushi rice (vinegar-seasoned)
- {酢|す}の{物|もの}: vinegared dishes (cucumber, etc.)
- {甘酢|あまず}: sweet vinegar
- {酢|す}{漬|づ}け: pickled in vinegar
- {南蛮漬|なんばんづ}け: fried fish in vinegar sauce

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {酢|す}をかける: to put vinegar on
- {酢|す}で{和|あ}える: to dress with vinegar
- {酢|す}に{漬|つ}ける: to pickle in vinegar

HEALTH BENEFITS:
{酢|す}は{体|からだ}にいい (Vinegar is good for health) is a common saying.
